# Embedded emissions: cannot be calculated

**The total cannot be determined because the CN code is missing.**

The ruleset requires three inputs:

| Required input | Provided? |
|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | ❌ No. "Steel product" is not a CN code. |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | ✅ China (listed for every good in the table) |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ 500 t |

Default SEE values are selected by CN code and country together. "Steel product" could match several CN codes in the table, and each has a different SEE for China. Under the ruleset, I must not estimate or assume a CN code.

## Candidate CN codes for China

These are shown for reference only. None of them is the answer.

| CN code | Good | China SEE (tCO2e/t) | Result if this CN code applies (× 500 t) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, iron and non-alloy steel | 1.74 | 870.00 tCO2e |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products, iron or non-alloy steel | 3.314 | 1,657.00 tCO2e |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods with indentations (rebar) | 3.169 | 1,584.50 tCO2e |

CN 7201 (pig iron, 1.66 tCO2e/t) is also in the table. It is pig iron, not steel, so it is unlikely to fit this description.

The possible results range from 870.00 to 1,657.00 tCO2e, a difference of almost a factor of two. This is why the exact classification matters.

## Next step

Please provide the CN code of the good, for example from the customs declaration or commercial invoice. I can then report the embedded emissions, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
